newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - November 14.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - November 14.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had one large one-day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The miss, which occurred on Wednesday, resulted in more reserves than expected because float was much higher than anticiapted, the Fed said.

As for the pattern of borrowing, 86 percent of the adjustment borrowing for the week was done by the small banks, and 14 percent was done by the large regionals. There was no borrowing by the money center banks.
On Wednesday, 41 percent of the borrowing was done by the small banks, while 59 percent was done by the large regionals.
The high in natural float was a bit under $4.4 billion on Wednesday, while the low was a bit over $500 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged about $170 million per day, with the high on Wednesday at about $500 million primarily due to weather-related delays in Cleveland.
